answer: Proof of Burn functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring the permanent destruction of a native token, acting as a financial nectar that anchors digital identity to real-world capital. An attacker wishing to flood the network must exhaust their holdings, effectively draining their ocean of resources to generate nodes. This creates a clear beacon for honest agents, as the high cost of entry makes creating thousands of fake identities economically irrational.
